description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application.

description.zh: 创建人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位。
description.en: The ID of the creator. The ID can be up to 36 characters in length and can contain only letters and digits.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions. Consider this limit when calling this operation. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-message-group --app-id a494caec-000-695ef345db77 --creator-id as0000hs --extension key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
